[[File:Arnold Oberschelp.jpg|thumb|Oberschelp in 1978]]
'''Arnold Oberschelp''' (5 February 1932 – 31 August 2024) was a German mathematician and [[logician]]. He was a professor of logic and science in [[Kiel]].

==Life and career==
Oberschelp studied mathematics and physics at the universities of [[University of Göttingen|Göttingen]] and [[University of Münster|Münster]]. In Münster he received in December 1957 his doctorate in mathematical logic under [[Hans Hermes]].<ref name="cau.gelehrtenverzeichnis">[https://cau.gelehrtenverzeichnis.de/person/81409b58-08f7-3851-d2dc-4d4c60bf1dfb Record] in Kiel University's academic database</ref><ref>[https://www.uni-muenster.de/FB10/historie Geschichte] [History of Münster University], Part II "1945&mdash;1969", [https://www.uni-muenster.de/FB10/historie/anhangC.pdf App.C "Mathematical Dissertations from 1945 to 1969"], p.322</ref><ref>Dissertation "Über die Axiome produktabgeschlossener arithmetischer Klassen [On the axioms of product-closed arithmetic classes]"</ref><ref>{{cite journal | url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/227062016 | author=Arnold Oberschelp | title=Über die Axiome produktabgeschlossener arithmetischer Klassen | journal=Archive for Mathematical Logic | volume=4 | number=3 | pages=95&ndash;123 | date=Jan 1958 | doi=10.1007/BF01973146 | s2cid=119721234 }} &mdash; '''Review:''' {{cite journal | jstor=2270214 |  author= J. Weinstein | title=Review | journal=The Journal of Symbolic Logic | volume=32 | number=4 | pages=532&ndash;533 | date=Dec 1967 | doi= 10.2307/2270214 | s2cid= 118127906 }}</ref> In 1958 he was a research assistant at the Mathematical Institute of the Technical College of Hannover (now [[Leibniz University Hannover]]) where he habilitated in mathematics in 1961.<ref name="cau.gelehrtenverzeichnis"/><ref>''Habilitation thesis:'' {{cite journal | url=http://www.digizeitschriften.de/dms/img/?PID=GDZPPN002289989 | author=Arnold Oberschelp | title=Untersuchungen zur mehrsortigen Quantorenlogik | journal=[[Mathematische Annalen]] | volume=145 | number=4 | pages=297&ndash;333 | date=1962 | doi=10.1007/BF01396685 | s2cid=123363080 | url-access=subscription }} &mdash; '''Review:''' {{cite journal | jstor=2964130 | author=H. Arnold Schmidt | title=Review | journal=The Journal of Symbolic Logic | volume=27 | number=2 | pages=225–226 | date=Jun 1962 }}</ref> In 1968, he accepted an appointment as full professor of logic and science at the [[University of Kiel]]. Oberschelp has been emeritus professor since 1997.<ref>''[http://www.math.uni-kiel.de/logik/de/arbeitsgruppe-logik/zur-geschichte-der-logik-in-kiel Zur Geschichte der Logik in Kiel]'' by Otmar Spinas</ref>

Arnold Oberschelp developed a general class logic in which arbitrary classes can be formed without the contradictions of naive [[set theory]]. Additional axioms result in the [[Zermelo–Fraenkel set theory]], which is much more handy in his class-logical representation than in the usual [[predicate logic]]al representation.<ref>Gegenüberstellung von ZFC in klassenlogischer und prädikatenlogischer Form [Comparison of ZFC in class logic vs. predicate logic form], in: Oberschelp, Allgemeine Mengenlehre, 1994, p.&nbsp;261</ref>

In 1962 he gave a lecture as an invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Stockholm on classes as "primal elements" in set theory.

From 1970 to 1976 he was chairman of the {{ill|Deutsche Vereinigung für mathematische Logik und für Grundlagenforschung der exakten Wissenschaften|de}},<ref>translated: ''German Association for Mathematical Logic and Foundational Research in the Exact Sciences''</ref> on whose board he served from 1965 to 1978.

In September 2019, he received the [[German Institute for Standardization]]'s Beuth Memorial Coin in recognition of his services to standardization in mathematics and technical foundations.<ref>[https://www.din.de/de/din-und-seine-partner/din-e-v/ehrungen/verleihung-der-beuth-denkmuenze-an-herrn-dr-rer-nat-arnold-oberschelp-655962 Verleihung der Beuth-Denkmünze an Herrn Dr. rer. nat. Arnold Oberschelp] (includes a 2019 photo)</ref>

Oberschelp died on 31 August 2024, at the age of 92.<ref>{{cite web |title=Arnold Oberschelp |url=https://trauer-anzeigen.de/traueranzeige/arnold-oberschelp |website=trauer-anzeigen |access-date=16 September 2024}}</ref>
